newsitem.title: USA: MCA Financial puts $500,000 in Westmark.
newsitem.headline: MCA Financial puts $500,000 in Westmark.

text.p: Westmark Group Holdings Inc said Monday that MCA Financial Corp, a lender specializing in sub-prime credit, has agreed to buy 100,000 shares of its convertible stock for $500,000.
As a part of this transaction, Westmark said that MCA Financial will also purchase as much as $16 million of Westmark's loan production between now and January, 1998.
Westmark is a diversified financial services holding company which, through its Westmark Mortgage division, originates and sells sub-prime credit home mortgages.
